name: Savorum
post_parameters: -ec mode=0700; [ ${SAVORUM_STORAGE_ACCESS:-owner} != group ] || mode=0770; chown 65532:65532 /data; chmod $mode /data; exec setpriv --reuid=65532 --regid=65532 --clear-groups --inh-caps=-all --ambient-caps=-all --bounding-set=-all --no-new-privs /savorum serve
description: Savorum is a free, open-source recipe manager. Save recipes from websites, PDFs, and photos, or import from Paprika, Mealie, Tandoor Recipes, and CookBook Manager. Organize books, plan meals, and build shopping lists. Scale ingredients and cook step by step with timers. Print recipes or export them with photos in SREF. Sign-in is off by default. Enable Authentication to use accounts and shared libraries. Configuration: https://docs.savorum.app/admin/configure/ Accounts: https://docs.savorum.app/admin/accounts/ Single sign-on: https://docs.savorum.app/admin/single-sign-on/ Remote access: https://docs.savorum.app/admin/remote-access/

variables.name: SSO config file
variables.description: JSON path inside the container. Requires authentication.
